words.rule: During the fall sweep, temporary No Parking signs go up 24 to 48 hours ahead: no parking 8 AM to 6 PM on the block's sweep date.
words.afterpass: Fall sweep Oct 19 to Nov 18, 2026, one day per block; the City can move a date for weather. Parked cars can be ticketed and towed.
words.dataNotes: Dates come from the City's Street Sweeping layer, the data behind its Street Sweep Map, which gives one date per block and no side, so both sides show it. Dates can move on short notice: the temporary signs on the block win. Arterial overnight bans (hours only on the signs) and snow emergencies are not shown. The City provides its GIS data as is, with no warranty; its full notice comes with the data file.
